- **Background work shows what went wrong first (FL-1486):** Settings › Computers & background work › Background work › Advanced now starts with what needs a look: failures grouped by what went wrong across every task, most photos first, each with one thing to do (Try again, Open Library care, Stop trying, or See the jobs). The server's own words are a click away.
- **Every task says why it is not running (FL-1486):** each task shows whether you paused it and when, whether it is heavy work waiting for tonight, whether it waits for another task, or whether its feature is off, with one button to Pause, Resume or Start now. Tasks with nothing to do are folded away. Work waiting for the night is no longer listed as paused.
- **New photos come first (FL-1478, FL-1479):** photos you upload or import are processed before the backlog of older work, and they keep their place at the front after a retry or while the server is busy.
- **Overnight work finishes (FL-1480):** heavy tasks no longer close for the day because of one quiet moment, and a night's step no longer waits on work that is not the night's.
- **Dismissing library setup stops it (FL-1481):** after Dismiss, setup starts no more library scans or file checks. Retry still brings it back.
- **Failures say what happened (FL-1482):** a failed job now keeps the real reason, so the list of failed jobs tells you what went wrong.
- **Google Photos from a folder works on every server (FL-1477):** every server now has a built-in Imports folder, so importing a Google Takeout from a folder on your server no longer needs any setup.
- **Manager has a Containers screen (FL-1476):** change each container's settings, ports and folders in Manager, where your changes are kept through updates. Overview, Storage, Backups and Updates are clearer too.
- **Large libraries stay fast (FL-1485):** finished jobs and their records no longer pile up in the database, which had slowed large servers down over a few days.
- **Shared videos are converted once (FL-1487):** a video shared with a partner uses the original's converted copy instead of being converted again.
- **The missing-file check reports every file (FL-1488):** the check no longer gives up on a group of files when two photos point at the same file.
- **Videos with an odd frame length keep their details (FL-1489):** a video whose file carries a nonsense frame length now gets its date, size and other details like any other video.
